_comments.id: Unique theme identifier used by preferences and dropdown selection.
_comments.name: Human-readable theme name shown in the App Theme dropdown.
_comments.version: Theme file version for future migrations.
_comments.base: Built-in CSS theme used as fallback for layout-specific styling.
_comments.tokens: Main application UI color tokens applied over the base theme.
_comments.overlayTokens: Overlay-specific color tokens applied to the achievements overlay window.
_comments.effects: Optional visual effects that cannot be represented as simple color tokens.
_comments.app-bg: Main app background color and global base color.
_comments.app-surface: Secondary surface color used by controls and raised UI elements.
_comments.app-text: Primary text color used across the interface.
_comments.app-muted: Muted text color used for secondary labels and helper text.
_comments.app-accent: Primary accent color used for buttons, highlights, and active states.
_comments.app-accent-2: Secondary accent color used for gradients, sliders, and secondary highlights.
_comments.app-success: Success color used for completed or positive states.
_comments.app-warning: Warning color used for caution states.
_comments.app-attention: Attention color used for special highlights.
_comments.app-danger: Danger color used for errors, destructive actions, and warnings.
_comments.app-pink: Additional accent color used by Dracula-compatible UI aliases.
_comments.app-backdrop: Backdrop color behind modals and overlay panels.
_comments.app-panel-bg: Primary panel background used by Settings, Dashboard, and modal panels.
_comments.app-panel-bg-strong: Stronger panel background used for deeper or nested surfaces.
_comments.app-card-bg: Dashboard card and content card background.
_comments.app-border-subtle: Subtle border color used around panels, cards, and controls.
_comments.app-select-bg-focus: Dropdown focused and expanded background color.
_comments.app-select-hover-bg: Dropdown hover background color before the option list opens.
_comments.app-select-border-focus: Dropdown focused and expanded border color.
_comments.app-select-option-bg: Dropdown expanded option list background color.
_comments.app-select-option-text: Dropdown expanded option list text color.
_comments.app-select-option-hover-bg: Dropdown expanded option hover and selected background color.
_comments.app-select-option-selected-bg: Dropdown expanded selected option background color. Also overrides the native white selection highlight.
_comments.app-select-option-selected-text: Dropdown expanded selected option text color.
_comments.app-image-bg: Fallback background shown behind covers and image containers.
_comments.app-overlay-bg-strong: Stronger overlay background used by the overlay shell.
_comments.app-overlay-surface: Overlay surface color used by rows and containers.
_comments.app-overlay-surface-soft: Softer overlay surface color used by nested areas.
_comments.app-overlay-hover: Overlay hover and active-item background color.
_comments.glass: Enables glass-style visual treatment for themes that use blur/transparency.
_comments.bodyBackground: Full app body background; supports solid colors or CSS gradients.
